title: Phone Number Config Sip
description: Configuration settings for configuring a Phone Number for SIP trunking.

type.description: The Application type that should be used. Can be either `directforwarding`, `flowbuilder`, `notification`, `sip`, `halo` or `none`.

distributionGroupGuid.description: Unique identifier of the Distribution Group.

algorithm.description: The algorithm for the distribution group that should be applied, can be either `RoundRobin` or `FailOver`.

fallbackDistributionGroupGuid.description: Unique identifier of the fallback Distribution Group.

fallbackAlgorithm.description: The algorithm for the fallback Distribution Group that should be applied, can be either `RoundRobin` or `FailOver`.

ApiPhoneNumberConfig.title: Phone Number Config

type.description: The Application type that should be used. Can be either `directforwarding`, `flowbuilder`, `notification`, `sip`, `halo` or `none`.

phoneNumber.description: The Phone Number that the current configuration applies to.

ApiPhoneNumberConfig.description: Model that represents the config of a phone number
